newsitem.title: USA: Senior House banking Democrat Gonzalez hospitalized.
newsitem.headline: Senior House banking Democrat Gonzalez hospitalized.

text.p: Representative Henry Gonzalez of Texas, the senior Democrat on the House Banking Committee, entered the hospital late Thursday after experiencing extreme fatigue and congestion, his office announced Friday.
Gonzalez, 81, "is in good spirits and looks forward to returning to his duties in the House," according to a statement issued by his congressional office.

On the recommendation of the attending physician of the House of Representatives, Dr. John Eisold, Gonzalez entered National Naval Medical Centre in Bethesda, Maryland, at 7 p.m. EDT and underwent a series of routine tests.
Gonzalez is in his 18th term and represents San Antonio. He chaired the banking committee for three terms.
